segment.text: 7. Nexxbase' s Services Nexxbase Services record your training data and health data, which will be used only for your private and non-commercial purposes. Below are the main functions of Luna Ring Services. (a) Account login: you need to create and log into your account while using the either your mobile number or through the email address, in order to manage and save your training data and health data. (b) Device management: Luna Ring Services allow you to manage your device. You can manage the use and upgrade of your device by connecting your device to your phone through Bluetooth function. You can manage your personal data on your device and/or in the APP, which will be displayed after processed through the APP. (c) Personal information management: you can edit your avatar, nickname, sex, age, height, weight and other information in the APP. (d) Training data recording: Luna Ring Services support the recording and display of your daily training data (walking, running, biking, swimming, etc.) and movement path (outdoor running, outdoor walking, outdoor biking, etc.) in your APP. To record your movement path, you need to enable the GPS function of your mobile phone. (e) Health data management: After binding your device, Luna Ring Services will support the measurement, recording and display of your health data (sleep, heart rate, SpO2, stress, etc.) on your respective APP. (f) Health reports: Generate your weekly, monthly and annual health reports based on your training data, health data and personal information, and push your health reports.
